A second matrix attempt rejected orphan containerd metadata left by the interrupted case before executing feature rows. The exact test-owned record was removed after proving its task and child were absent.

Early setup and audit failures are retained: overly long Go Unix socket test paths, deployment input ownership, missing kernel config artifact, unsupported audit CLI subcommand, and reboot fixture service/mount setup. Runtime source was unchanged during correction.
